by
  have key : ∀ (m : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ), r 1 = m → (∀ k, r (k + 1) ≠ 0 → r (k + 2) = r k % r (k + 1)) → ∃ N, r (N + 1) = 0 ∧ r N = Nat.gcd (r 0) (r 1) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ m ih =>
      intro r hm hr
      by_cases h0 : r 1 = 0
      · exact ⟨0, h0, by simp [h0]⟩
      · have hlt : r 2 = r 0 % r 1 := hr 0 h0
        have hm2 : r 2 < m := by
          rw [hlt, ← hm]
          exact Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0)
        obtain ⟨N, hN1, hN2⟩ := ih (r 2) hm2 (fun k => r (k + 1)) rfl (fun k hk => hr (k + 1) hk)
        refine ⟨N + 1, hN1, ?_⟩
        have hN3 : r (N + 1) = Nat.gcd (r 1) (r 2) := hN2
        rw [hN3, hlt, Nat.gcd_comm (r 0) (r 1), Nat.gcd_rec (r 1) (r 0)]
        exact Nat.gcd_comm _ _
  intro a b r h0 h1 hr
  subst h0 h1
  exact key _ r rfl hr
